The show follows the patrons of a cozy little restaurant tucked away in the backstreets of Shinjuku, which is only open during the unusual hours o … Read the full story at The Verge. ]]> Victoria Song https://www.theverge.com/?p=1042483 2026-11-26T11:56:43-05:00 2026-11-26T14:00:00-05:00 The Forerunner 265S is great for runners with small wrists. | Photo by Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge The Forerunner 265S may not be the newest or flashiest Garmin, but it’s one that I’ve always loved most in testing. For runners with smaller wrists, it fits nicely. The battery life is pretty good thanks in part to its OLED touchscreen. When I reviewed it a few years ago, I called it the Goldilocks of fitness watches at the time, and the only thing that bugged me was its price. But now that it’s down to $299.99 (a $150 discount off its MSRP) at Amazon and Best Buy for Black Friday, I can easily recommend it. Garmin Forerunner 265S (42mm) Garmin’s Forerunner 265S is identical to the standard 265, only it features a slightly better battery life and a smaller 42mm build for those with more petite wrists. Where to Buy: $449.99 $299.99 at Amazon $449.99 $299.99 at Best Buy The neat thing about Garmins in general is that you really don’t need the latest models to get the most out of the company’s platform. Its watches tend to get firmware updates for several years after launch, which is how long the average Garmin user tends to hold on to theirs. This particular watch is best suited for folks who want something a bit slimmer and smaller, enjoy a pop of color, and want a little extra fitness tracking prowess — but don’t need the whole kit and caboodle that sends the price up by hundreds. There are a few other Garmin models I like that are also on sale during Black Friday. I wish that I had 10 arms to fully vet every single last one, but alas. That said, here are some others that I have tested and recommend: The Garmin Fenix 8 is $749 at Amazon , Best Buy , and REI , which is a 25 percent discount off its original price. Its higher price comes down to having more features than the Forerunner 265S, so it’s really best for someone who does multiple outdoor sports and could make use of its handy LED flashlight. Garmin’s Venu 4 is $449 at Amazon , Best Buy , and REI , an 18 percent discount. This is a great option if you’re looking for more of a smartwatch that does fitness than a fitness-y watch that looks like a smartwatch. It’s a fine line, but if you know, you know. Finally, Garmin’s Forerunner 970 is $100 off, costing $649 at Amazon , Best Buy , and REI . This is what I’d recommend to marathoners who need something a bit more robust but not as heavy-duty as the flagship Fenix line. I’ve used it to train for a few races and it’s a solid upper-midrange (for Garmin!) option. ]]> Brad Bourque https://www.theverge.com/?p=1035932 2026-11-26T12:15:53-05:00 2026-11-26T12:07:00-05:00 This thing is poised to eat their lunch. | Photo: Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge If you’re looking for a new laptop or a gift for the student in your life, you can save $100 on the MacBook Neo at several retailers, in both storage sizes and all four colors. MacBook Neo Where to Buy: $799 $699.99 at Amazon (512GB, Touch ID) $699 $599.99 at Amazon (256GB) $699 $599.99 at Costco (256GB) Apple’s budget-friendly MacBook leverages the A18 Pro processor, a chip originally found in the iPhone 16 Pro, to keep costs down.
